posts.neutral_rendition:
I believe almost nothing on this list has achieved adoption. I regard ZODL, Vizor and Ledger as the wallets with meaningful penetration. I predict Metamask will not support snaps much longer, say Nym did not integrate with widely used mobile wallets, and claim THORChain and Avalanche Red Bridge have zero volume compared with NEAR Intents. I consider YWallet’s interface much worse than Vizor desktop, despite Vizor existing for only three months.

I consider Ledger the only important item. I say Zcash Labs had to take it over because a governance crisis prevented an additional $80,000 for Ledger Ironwood. I do not credit ZCAP/ZCG with success when, in my account, it had $100 million yet failed to finish the most important integration after more than a year’s delay.

I attribute this to lack of accountability and allege self-dealing: people with projects join ZCAP, which elects ZCG, which then selects funding.

editor_analysis.text: These are two separate claims: the projects had poor outcomes, and self-dealing caused those outcomes. The post offers a proposed electoral mechanism but no evidence of an actual conflicted award.
